OAuth.//Audience: The Entra App ID URI, with NO trailing slash — Entra refuses to register one on identifierUris. Deliberately NOT equal to Resource; see docs/runbooks/entra-app-registration.md.
OAuth.//Resource: Published in RFC 9728 and validated against. Keeps the trailing slash, because that is what Claude Code normalises to.
OAuth.//UpstreamResourceScope: Set => the RFC 8707 resource parameter is validated and then terminated here, with this scope naming the API upstream instead. Leave empty on Auth0, where the relayed resource is the only thing binding the audience.

Authorization.//CustomPermissionsClaim: Only consulted when LiveGroupCheck is false. With it true — every deployed target — entitlement comes from Graph alone, and no claim can grant access. The Auth0 Action that used to mint this claim was retired at the #108 cutover.
